publications.title: Encryptor v7
publications.abstract: This is A Project I have been working on for a while to provide a secure way to encrypt and decrypt through stacking encryption techniques with obfuscation techniques and implementing integrity checks. When you download it, please delete "DELETEME" in PGPKeys, it was a placeholder so git let me upload the essential folder How do I use it? Please read INSTRUCTIONS.txt which contains project information, setup instructions and then usage instructions including how to share messages with friends. If you have any issues or errors, please check Troubleshooting.txt which contains common issues people might be having and the solutions to them and also contains contact informatin to contact me if your issue isnt listed What does it Actually do? This Project takes any message or piece of text, encrypts it with AES-256 in GCM mode (which is the hardest to crack), adds a few informational parts onto it like a hash and password number, encrypts it with PGP then uses invisible unicode characters that dont visually appear (as in theyre there but dont take up any space) to make an invisible message that you can send it to your friend who uses a shared password list and their PGP Keypair to verify the message wasnt changed and decrypt the message. This project also implements a mandatory policy which makes your password lists to stay locked while you use it so if someone found the password files they're encrypted alredy and are only decrypted when you need to use them. My project also deletes used passwords from the list and attaches data telling the person you sent it to which password to automatically delete so no one can look up that password number (index). it also uses multiple (and changable) invisible unicode characters so someone cant just decode the message into binary to start cracking it.

publications.title: mdcx: verified conversion of document collections to queryable Markdown
publications.abstract: Converts complete document collections to Markdown, checking each file against the text the original actually exposes, packages the resulting corpus with its index and provenance into a single encrypted file, and exposes it to agents through the Model Context Protocol. Over a collection of 99 documents, answering one query through the package costs 435 model tokens against the 2,265,488 required to read the originals.

publications.title: Pierre Deligne - Collected Papers: English and French Editions
publications.abstract: Start reading: Deligne_EN.pdf is the 258-page cumulative English reader; Deligne_FR.pdf is the separate 268-page cumulative French reader. Sparse maintained coverage: the readers include every independently audited complete work currently ready for preservation, in numerical order: D001-D012, D014, D015, D021, D025 and D026. D013, D016-D020 and D022-D024 are explicit gaps in this version; later completed gap works can be inserted in their numerical positions without withholding later complete works. Source and audit: Deligne_EN.tex and Deligne_FR.tex are the maintained reader masters. Deligne_Source.zip contains the editable work-level TeX, standalone editions, authorities, apparatus and image fallbacks. DELIGNE_PROVENANCE_AUDIT_D026.zip is the single consolidated audit carrier, including the exact superseded public bytes and the independent gates for D021, D025 and D026. Edition model: French and English remain separate books; no side-by-side or interleaved reader is claimed.
